snacs_adapt_rules.txt:
Useful adaptation rules from examples and guidelines:
1) to can be Org;Goal when indicating destination/target institution or place to go to.
2) of in partitive/whole expressions is QuantityItem;Whole (e.g., each of you).
3) of after pride/proud can mark Stimulus;Topic (object of emotion-like predicate).
4) your before money in recommend/take your money elsewhere is Possessor;Possessor.
5) by in by saying is Means;Means.
6) at/on with concrete places or venues are Locus;Locus.
7) throughout in time expressions is Duration;Duration.
8) Possessive pronouns used before nouns can be Possessor;Possessor even in advice/transfer expressions.
9) Prefer the more specific temporal label when an explicit duration span is expressed (throughout the year => Duration, not Time).
10) of in 'a great job of V-ing' can be Identity;Identity.
11) on with a possessed item/object can be Theme;Theme (e.g., maintenance on my hooptie).
